text: I can use Little's law to show how fast one hanging dependency exhausts a shared thread pool, and size a per-dependency bulkhead with headroom.
I can choose between a thread-pool and a semaphore bulkhead and name what a bulkhead does not protect against.
I can explain goodput collapse under overload with numbers and why rejecting the excess early keeps most requests succeeding.
I can design criticality tiers, compute who survives a spike when shedding by priority, and prevent shed requests from returning as retries.
I can distinguish admission control from rate limiting and pick an admission signal (fixed or adaptive concurrency, queue wait, CPU) for a given service.
